title: One coverage obligation of the launch contract
description: One entry of `coverage` of the launch contract (feature 107). The id is `OBL-` followed by the first 12 hexadecimal characters, upper-cased, of the content hash of the text `<source>:<line>:<task id>:<text>` (F107-FR-004, the content hash of the canonical hasher of @specstride/kernel). The kinds and the dispositions are the members of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 79 that annex G §G.8 gives (the record schema `launch-contract.schema.json` of @specstride/contracts names them); the members of `timing` are the closed set of row 257 (`timingOfACoverageObligation`) and of `producer` the closed set of row 258 (`producerOfACoverageObligation`), read from @specstride/contracts, never copied by hand. Strict validation refuses the dispositions `unresolved` and `unsupported` and the producers `unknown` and `unclassified` (a rule of validation, F107-FR-004, F107-FR-041).

id.description: The id of the obligation: OBL- plus 12 hexadecimal characters, upper-cased (F107-FR-004)

anyOf.description: The literal members of the closed set

The parameterized member `after:<stage>` of the closed set, the id of a stage

timing.description: The timing of the obligation; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 257 (timingOfACoverageObligation of @specstride/contracts), the literal members as their enum and the parameterized members as their patterns

anyOf.description: The literal members of the closed set
The parameterized member `stage:<id>` of the closed set, the id of a stage

producer.description: The producer of the obligation; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 258 (producerOfACoverageObligation of @specstride/contracts), the literal members as their enum and the parameterized member as its pattern
